title: TWO NECKLACES. (the neighbour will ask for one.)
format: carousel, 4 slides at 1080x1440: S1 video loop 10.0 s (300 frames at 30 fps, frame 0 = the cover = the grid tile, frame 299 leading into frame 0 by one ordinary step, soft baked foley), S2-S4 stills. date: Fri 13 Nov 2026 (never dated on any image)
caption:
Two necklaces in one set, which in this building means the neighbour will ask to borrow one before the first sangeet.

The Marquise Layering Set: a fine 40 cm cable chain holding a single marquise cubic zirconia, and a 45 cm Y-lariat with marquise stations and a drop of about 9 cm, so it falls just below the first. Worn together, the layering is already done. 18k gold tone plated. ₹1,599 for both.

Or get her her own set. Take 2 pieces for 10% off or 3 for 20% off. The bag applies BUY2 or BUY3 for you.

[ marquise layering set · 18k gold tone plated · ask for it back ]
first_comment: Tag the neighbour who will ask. Every piece arrives in our blush box · free insured shipping · COD available #NairaFlore #WeddingGuest #LayeredNecklace #DemiFineJewellery #NairaPetite
alt_text: An illustrated pink Art Deco window into a bottle-green room where a ceiling fan's shadow turns slowly on the wall, under the words TWO NECKLACES and 'the neighbour will ask for one.' Close up, a wide teak dressing-table mirror hangs on the wall, and tucked into the corner of its frame is a small note: 'can i borrow the long one for the sangeet? 203'. Over the mirror's lower rail hang two fine gold-tone necklaces against the green wall, in a warm pool of lamplight: one falling in a V to a marquise pendant, and a Y-shaped lariat whose two arms meet at a small round stone, its drop falling straight down through a marquise station. In the loop a draught lifts the note off the glass and it settles back into the frame, then a soft light runs across the chains and both stones sparkle. A pink paper lantern turns at the left; below the window a brass plate carries the Naira wordmark and FLAT 202.

Close on the same dressing table. The note from 203, tucked into the mirror's frame, reads 'can i borrow the long one for the sangeet? 203'. On the teak below, close up, the gold-tone marquise pendant on its fine cable chain, and behind it the lariat's chain with a small marquise station, both running back under the mirror. Along the bottom: FROM 203, WITH LOVE AND A REQUEST.

The listing photograph: the two gold-tone pendants of the Marquise Layering Set lying on a cream plaster block, a marquise cubic zirconia in a claw setting in front and the lariat's stones behind, with the words ONE CHAIN, ONE MARQUISE. ONE Y-LARIAT. and the facts: a 40 cm cable chain, 1.2 mm, and a 45 cm Y-lariat, its drop about 9 cm.

End card on blush plaster: a brass plate with the Naira wordmark, then FLAT 202 · SECOND FLOOR, MARQUISE LAYERING SET, [ 18k gold tone plated · sold as a set of two ], ₹1,599 for both, 'or get her her own.', nairaflore.com, and every piece arrives in our blush box · free insured shipping · COD available.
sound: Slide 1 carries baked, very soft synthesised foley (nothing licensed; p08/_build/sfx.py; peak -24.5 dBFS in the wav): a faint ceiling-fan hum through the whole loop, built periodic over the track so the seam has no step; a soft paper lift at 3.0 s as the draught lifts the chit, a quieter rustle at 4.8 s as it starts to settle and a tiny paper tap at 6.15 s as it lands; one small bright ting at 7.11 s as the marquise sparkles (re-synthesised 27 Oct at 7.108 s, the re-hung marquise's sparkle peak; was 7.114). Optional in-app: a soft sitar or string instrumental from the Instagram audio library, no vocals, ducked under the foley. Slides 2-4 are stills.
